articles.summary: metal : add NVFP4 support Follow the MXFP4 path: add the UE4M3 scale decode, the NVFP4 dequantizers, a dedicated mat-vec kernel with its MUL_MAT_ID, small-batch and MMA variants, the mul_mm / mul_mm_id and tensor-op variants, and the get_rows and cpy kernels. Enable the type in supports_op. Tested on an M5 Max with ggm
